visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium close-up of a sleek black cat lying on a white pillow with blue stripes. The cat is leaning against a large, bright pink crescent-shaped cushion. The cat performs a wide, deep yawn, stretching its jaw to reveal a pink tongue and sharp teeth while its eyes are squinted shut. Long white whiskers stand out against the cat's dark fur. The lighting is soft and comes from the top right, suggesting natural daylight from a nearby window. (2) As the cat finishes its yawn, it closes its mouth but leaves a small portion of its pink tongue protruding in a 'blep' expression. It opens its eyes, which appear dark or green-tinted, and begins to look around the room. The background shows a dark wooden surface, possibly a headboard, and some soft blue bedding. The camera remains static and steady. (3) The cat begins to stretch its limbs. It extends its front left paw forward onto the striped pillow, followed by raising its right front paw upward and toward the camera. The cat splay its toes wide, clearly showing its black claws and the texture of its paw pads. It turns its head further to the right, looking at something off-screen with an inquisitive expression.
